invariant: TakeoverWorkerCanCommit: When an active worker's lease expires, reassignExecutionLease must successfully transfer the lease in ExecutionEngine to the takeover worker at an incremented epoch, and allow the new worker to commit
preconditions: Worker A holds lease at epoch 1; lease expires past TTL; RecoveryManager reassigns execution to Worker B at epoch 2
sequence: 1. Worker A acquires lease for execution E at t0; 2. Clock advances past lease TTL (lease expires); 3. RecoveryManager calls reassignExecutionLease(E, workerB, { now: tExpired }); 4. reassignExecutionLease calls releaseLease for Worker A; 5. releaseLease invokes assertLease which throws StaleWorkerLeaseError because lease expired; 6. catch block suppresses error and skips acquireLease; 7. Worker B is assigned epoch 2 in RecoveryManager but ExecutionEngine remains at epoch 1 held by Worker A; 8. Worker B's commits (setResult, setStatus) are rejected by ExecutionEngine with StaleWorkerLeaseError
test_path: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
observed: reassignExecutionLease updates ExecutionEngine lease to Worker B at epoch 2 and allows Worker B to commit
patch: reassignExecutionLease caught StaleWorkerLeaseError during releaseLease, skipped acquireLease, leaving ExecutionEngine wedged at epoch 1 held by Worker A; Worker B's commit threw StaleWorkerLeaseError
post_fix_evidence: Only invoke releaseLease if existing lease is unexpired (expiresAt > now); expired lease is directly taken over by acquireLease

invariant: AuthoritativeReleaseIdempotent: A worker holding the current unreleased lease should be able to release it without throwing, even if current time has passed expiresAt
preconditions: Worker A holds lease at epoch 1; lease expires (now >= expiresAt); Worker A releases its lease
sequence: 1. Worker A acquires lease at t0; 2. Time advances past expiry; 3. Worker A completes teardown and calls releaseLease(E, 'worker-a', { leaseEpoch: 1, now: tExpired }); 4. releaseLease calls assertLease; 5. assertLease unconditionally checks current.expiresAt <= now and throws StaleWorkerLeaseError; 6. Worker A cannot release its lease
observed: releaseLease resolves undefined and marks lease released
patch: releaseLease rejected with StaleWorkerLeaseError: Lease for execution held by worker-a expired at ...
post_fix_evidence: Added allowExpired flag to assertLease, passed true from releaseLease; release succeeds idempotently if caller is current holder and epoch matches
status: Vitest workerLeasesHardening.test.ts passes (3/3); all 52 recovery/lease tests pass
column19: Does not permit release if another worker has already acquired a higher epoch (which throws Stale lease epoch)

invariant: FencedCommitAuthoritativeOnly: Every mutating operation on an actively leased execution must present valid lease claimant credentials matching the current holder and epoch
preconditions: Execution has an active lease held by Worker A at epoch 1; a caller attempts mutating operations without passing claimant credentials
sequence: 1. Execution is leased to Worker A; 2. A stale caller or unauthenticated writer calls setResult, setStatus, or recordToolStart with options omitted or without lease credentials; 3. assertLease saw claimant == null or empty credentials and immediately returned without checking current active lease; 4. Mutation committed without lease verification, bypassing worker lease fencing
test_path: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
observed: Mutating operations on an actively leased execution reject uncredentialed calls with StaleWorkerLeaseError
patch: Mutations without credentials were unconditionally permitted, completely bypassing active worker lease fencing
post_fix_evidence: Enforced that when an execution has an active unreleased lease, assertLease requires claimant credentials and rejects uncredentialed worker mutations; exempted system lifecycle events (execution.*, lease.*)
